sonnet.problem: The question says the wine runs out 'Right in the middle of the wedding.' John 2:3 only says 'When the wine ran out,' so the card adds a point in the wedding the text doesn't give.
sonnet.rule: **Times stay true.** No time in the text means none added.

sonnet.problem: The true or false statement about Jesus' 'third' sign comes before any story card has told verse 11. Nothing earlier on a card, such as the sign, signs or a count, lets the baker reason to the answer, so a pick is a coin flip. The story card that tells verse 11 (card 16) only comes after.
sonnet.rule: Before each choice card, Papa Dorin's story card gives enough context that the baker can reason their way to the answer.

sonnet.problem: The joke repeats the punchline shape of card 9: people in the passage do something easily, and Papa Dorin can't manage a tiny task ('I can't keep two oven mitts together' vs. 'tell me to carry a cup... I've got FIVE questions').
sonnet.rule: Each joke idea, comparison and punchline shape is used once per lesson.
